hero.headline: Suwa Shin Knocked on Five Hundred Doors to Ask for a Shower
hero.dek: Over six months the Japanese photographer rang or knocked at five hundred doors in her own apartment building with a single unusual request: to take a shower in the stranger's flat. Michael Scurr made the identification in May. The sheet had been carried aboard the American privateer Dalton, seized off Portugal by HM Raisonable on Christmas Eve that year, and filed with the prize papers ever since. It is the only Exeter broadside known outside the United States.
